classification: post-hoc fixed 50/50 ensemble of already frozen Top10 and Top20 A/B sleeves

costs.stock_main: 2x stock costs inherited from frozen caches
costs.stock_stress: 3x/4x/5x stock costs inherited from frozen caches

discipline: One fixed 50/50 ensemble; no blend-weight or TopN scan
Reuse only frozen R344/R346 caches after exact control reconstruction
No paper target or order file
Preserve preflight failures, amendments and execution failures
disclosure: R344-R349 results were observed before this round. R350 is explicitly post-hoc and tests one fixed 50/50 ensemble; no blend weight, TopN level, lookback, cap, cost or threshold scan is permitted. The preflight inspected only cache completeness and holdings overlap. No R350 ensemble return, drawdown, trade or concentration result was inspected before this file was frozen.
economic_rationale: The A Top10/Top20 active-holding Jaccard is 0.4827 and the B pair is 0.3978; Top20 adds 47/36 symbols not held by the corresponding Top10 over the full cache. The ensemble therefore combines the same investment thesis at two breadth levels instead of selecting a third factor family.

ensemble_rule.A: 50/50 monthly-rebalanced ensemble of the frozen A Top10 and A Top20 curves
ensemble_rule.B: 50/50 monthly-rebalanced ensemble of the frozen B Top10 and B Top20 curves
ensemble_rule.defensive_bucket: frozen R344 gold 200-day trend proxy plus one-third gold/treasury/dividend bucket
ensemble_rule.monthly_rebalance: reset each A/B sub-sleeve to 50/50 monthly after marked-to-market drift
ensemble_rule.outer_portfolio: monthly 60-day inverse-vol risk parity across ensemble A/B and C with [0.20, 0.60] bounds, cap C at 10%, then equity sleeve at most 1/3
ensemble_rule.overlay: 60-day lookback, 15% balance-vol target, gross [0.20, 1.00], no leverage

absolute_performance_2x.G10_no_leverage: max weight sum <=1, min target weight >=0

concentration.C12: max weight sum <=1, min target weight >=0

data.D2_preflight: v2 all checks true and no returns evaluated
data.D3_controls_reconstructed: R344 and R346 center 2x stats reproduced within 2e-6 from frozen caches
data.D4_cache_stable: all 60 R344/R346 cache files remain byte-hash stable

robustness.F1_fresh: at least 5/6 fresh starts positive and every MDD >= -18%
robustness.P1_overlay: >=7/9 overlay lookback/target variants pass core gates
robustness.P2_joint: >=2/3 joint target variants pass core gates

satellite_cap_plateau.P4: at least 3/4 caps pass and the 10% center passes
satellite_cap_plateau.per_cap_core: 2x annual >=12%, Sharpe >=1.25, MDD >= -15%; 5x annual >=10%, Sharpe >=1.10, MDD >= -15%; 5x C2-C4 pass; at least 5/6 fresh starts positive

hypothesis: A fixed 50/50 monthly ensemble of the narrower Top10 and broader Top20 A/B sleeves retains most of the narrow-sleeve alpha while diluting single-name dependence enough to improve 5x net-profit concentration and preserve drawdown control, without scanning TopN or blend weights.
known_limitations: R350 is post-hoc after observing R344-R349 results and is not an independent out-of-sample discovery.
The ensemble rebalance cost is an approximation; underlying strategy trade costs are already in the cached curves.
Top10 and Top20 caches come from reconstructed historical membership and current-snapshot industry classification.
ETF qfq caches are not official PIT total-return data.
The common window starts in 2022 because TTM data for the C sleeve begins then.
Net-contribution concentration remains fragile when total net profit is thin.
selection_rule: All D/G/T/X/C/R/F/P gates must pass. Otherwise record the result as research-only negative evidence and do not promote or generate paper targets. No threshold, blend weight, TopN, cap or window changes after results.
